name: explain-for-dumb
title_zh: git diff 的傻瓜版人类翻译官
tagline_zh: 分支 diff 或未提交改动，它用大白话讲给你听：原本是什么、发生了什么、怎么改的。还能按文件逐个过。
tagline_en: Branch diff or uncommitted changes, told as a story: what was, what happened, how. Or per-file walkthrough. No.
desc_en: Explains code changes (branch diff vs master, or uncommitted changes) in plain human language, no scary jargon — so the user understands what an agent (or they) actually changed. Two modes - a "for dummies" story (what was, what happened, how it was done) or a per-file walkthrough. Use when the user says "explain-for-dumb", "explain my changes", "what did the agent do", "walk me through the diff",
why_zh: 它不罗列 diff 行，而是讲一个「发生了什么」的故事。两种模式：整体叙事或逐文件走查。
why_en: Instead of listing diff lines, it narrates the change. Two modes — story or per-file — so even non-coders grasp what an agent or.
limit_zh: 只处理 git 仓库内的 diff（分支对比或未提交改动）；不解释单文件内容、不回答代码问题、不做代码审查。
limit_en: Only git diffs (branch vs master or uncommitted). No single-file Q&A, no code review. Needs git repo with readable diff.
title_en: A plain-human translator for git diff
